title: New Jersey deploys joint rescue team to Texas
description:
Four Army National Guard pilots and crew chiefs from the 1-150 Assault Helicopter Battalion, and four Air National Guard tactical air control party Airmen from the 227th Air Support Operations Squadron, flying two UH-60 Black Hawks, one outfitted with rescue hoist and equipment, departed Joint Base McGuire-Dix-Lakehurst, N.J. on Aug. 30, 2017 to support operations in Texas after Hurricane Harvey.

Talent: Master Sgt. Chris Donohue, 227th Air Support Operations Squadron, New Jersey Air National Guard
